whatsappMessage:
Hi Hair Sports Unisex Salon team,

I noticed your salon has exceptional 4.9★ reviews from over 450 clients in Mithapur, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for direct appointment bookings.

Maine aapke salon ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp booking, hair & grooming services menu, aur client gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/hairsports

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Hair Sports Unisex Salon team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke salon ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
